name: Short-Excess Report
query:
SELECT
    sc.name AS "Stock Correction",
    sci.item_code AS "Item Code",
    sci.item_name AS "Item Name",
    sci.warehouse AS "Warehouse",
    ROUND(sci.qty, 3) AS "Quantity (Delta)",
    sci.uom AS "UOM",
    sc.branch AS "Branch",
    sc.posting_date AS "Posting Date",
    CASE
        WHEN sci.qty < 0 THEN ROUND(ABS(sci.qty), 3)
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Short",
    CASE
        WHEN sci.qty > 0 THEN ROUND(sci.qty, 3)
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Excess",
    CASE
        WHEN sci.qty < 0 THEN 'Short'
        WHEN sci.qty > 0 THEN 'Excess'
        ELSE 'No Change'
    END AS "Type"
FROM `tabStock Correction` sc
JOIN `tabStock Correction Item` sci ON (
    sc.name = sci.parent
)
WHERE
    sc.branch = %(branch)s
    AND sc.posting_date >= %(start_date)s
    AND sc.posting_date <= %(end_date)s
    AND sc.docstatus = 1
    AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR sci.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
ORDER BY
    sc.posting_date DESC,
    sci.item_code
